recipe-section-1.markdown:
- **Fresh blueberries**: 900 g ([**0:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=14s))
- **White granulated sugar**: 150 g ([**5:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=305s))
- **Brown sugar**: 60 g ([**5:05**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=305s))
- **All-purpose flour**: 30 g ([**4:16**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=256s))
- **Cornstarch**: 30 g *(Crucial for the pie's structure so it cuts cleanly)* ([**4:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=276s))
- **Fresh lemon juice**: 60 mL (approx. 1 medium-to-small lemon) ([**1:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=115s))
- **Lemon zest**: 19.5 mL (the zest of the whole lemon) ([**0:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=28s))
- **Vanilla paste**: 5 mL ([**2:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=162s))
- **Ground cinnamon**: 2 g ([**2:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=172s))
- **Ground ginger**: 1 g ([**3:03**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=183s))
- **Ground cardamom**: 1 g *(Aaron's secret weapon for brightening fruit notes)* ([**3:09**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=189s))
- **Sea salt**: 1 g ([**3:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=224s))
recipe-section-1.html:
• Fresh blueberries: 900 g (0:14)
  • White granulated sugar: 150 g (5:05)
  • Brown sugar: 60 g (5:05)

  • Cornstarch: 30 g (Crucial for the pie's structure so it cuts cleanly) (4:36)
  • Fresh lemon juice: 60 mL (approx. 1 medium-to-small lemon) (1:55)
  • Lemon zest: 19.5 mL (the zest of the whole lemon) (0:28)
  • Vanilla paste: 5 mL (2:42)
  • Ground cinnamon: 2 g (2:52)
  • Ground ginger: 1 g (3:03)
  • Ground cardamom: 1 g (Aaron's secret weapon for brightening fruit notes) (3:09)
  • Sea salt: 1 g (3:44)
recipe-section-1.title: The Blueberry Filling

recipe-section-2.markdown:
- **Gluten-free pie crust**: 2 pre-made frozen disks *(Aaron makes his for a gluten-intolerant guest)* ([**7:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=454s))
- **Unsalted butter**: Small knobs for the filling holes + extra melted for brushing the top ([**17:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=1052s))
- **Crystal sugar**: A heavy handful for a crunch finish ([**18:29**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=1109s))
recipe-section-2.html:
• Gluten-free pie crust: 2 pre-made frozen disks (Aaron makes his for a gluten-intolerant guest) (7:34)
  • Unsalted butter: Small knobs for the filling holes + extra melted for brushing the top (17:32)
  • Crystal sugar: A heavy handful for a crunch finish (18:29)
recipe-section-2.title: The Crust & Topping Finish

recipe-section-4.markdown: - Rinse and dump 900 g of fresh blueberries into a large bowl ([**0:09**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=9s)). Finely zest the yellow skin of a whole lemon directly into the bowl, being careful not to hit the bitter white pith ([**0:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=28s)). Squeeze out exactly 60 mL of the fresh lemon juice and add it to the berries ([**1:55**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=115s)). Add 5 mL of vanilla paste, 2 g of cinnamon, 1 g of ginger, 1 g of cardamom, and 1 g of sea salt ([**2:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=162s)).
recipe-section-4.html: • Rinse and dump 900 g of fresh blueberries into a large bowl (0:09). Finely zest the yellow skin of a whole lemon directly into the bowl, being careful not to hit the bitter white pith (0:28). Squeeze out exactly 60 mL of the fresh lemon juice and add it to the berries (1:55). Add 5 mL of vanilla paste, 2 g of cinnamon, 1 g of ginger, 1 g of cardamom, and 1 g of sea salt (2:42).
recipe-section-4.title: Step 1: Toss the Fruit Filling

recipe-section-5.markdown: - Weigh and add 30 g of all-purpose flour, 30 g of cornstarch, 150 g of white sugar, and 60 g of brown sugar directly into the fruit mixture ([**4:16**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=256s)). Use a large spoon to fold everything together very gently ([**5:29**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=329s)). Do not smash the berries; you want the oven's high heat to pop them naturally during the bake ([**6:10**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=370s)). Set the bowl aside ([**6:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=392s)). []
recipe-section-5.html: • Weigh and add 30 g of all-purpose flour, 30 g of cornstarch, 150 g of white sugar, and 60 g of brown sugar directly into the fruit mixture (4:16). Use a large spoon to fold everything together very gently (5:29). Do not smash the berries; you want the oven's high heat to pop them naturally during the bake (6:10). Set the bowl aside (6:32). []
recipe-section-5.title: Step 2: Bind the Sugars and Starches
recipe-section-5.heading_html: Step 2: Bind the Sugars and Starches

recipe-section-6.markdown: - Generously dust your pastry mat and rolling pin with flour ([**7:04**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=424s)). If your gluten-free pie dough disks are frozen solid, place them in an 80 °C oven for exactly 1 minute to make them pliable but still cold ([**8:44**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=524s)). Gently roll the first disk out from the center into a wide circle, patching any small edge cracks with your fingers ([**9:19**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=559s)).
recipe-section-6.html: • Generously dust your pastry mat and rolling pin with flour (7:04). If your gluten-free pie dough disks are frozen solid, place them in an 80 °C oven for exactly 1 minute to make them pliable but still cold (8:44). Gently roll the first disk out from the center into a wide circle, patching any small edge cracks with your fingers (9:19).
recipe-section-6.title: Step 3: Roll the Bottom Crust

recipe-section-7.markdown: - Roll the flattened dough loosely onto your rolling pin and transfer it over your pie dish ([**10:34**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=634s)). Press it gently down into the corners, leaving a bit of overhang ([**10:42**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=642s)). Place the lined tin straight into the freezer to firm up while you prep the top ([**11:41**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=701s)).
recipe-section-7.html: • Roll the flattened dough loosely onto your rolling pin and transfer it over your pie dish (10:34). Press it gently down into the corners, leaving a bit of overhang (10:42). Place the lined tin straight into the freezer to firm up while you prep the top (11:41).
recipe-section-7.title: Step 4: Line and Chill the Pie Tin
recipe-section-7.heading_html: Step 4: Line and Chill the Pie Tin

recipe-section-8.markdown: - Preheat your oven to 205 °C ([**14:57**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=897s)). Pull your chilled bottom crust from the freezer and dump the spiced blueberry filling evenly into it ([**13:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=804s)). Roll out your second dough disk on the floured mat ([**11:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=706s)). Use a pizza cutter to slice long, uniform strips across the dough ([**14:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=846s)). []
recipe-section-8.html: • Preheat your oven to 205 °C (14:57). Pull your chilled bottom crust from the freezer and dump the spiced blueberry filling evenly into it (13:24). Roll out your second dough disk on the floured mat (11:46). Use a pizza cutter to slice long, uniform strips across the dough (14:06). []
recipe-section-8.title: Step 5: Load the Filling and Cut Lattice Strips
recipe-section-8.heading_html: Step 5: Load the Filling and Cut Lattice Strips

recipe-section-9.markdown: - Lay the cut strips over the top of the blueberries in a woven lattice or a clean zigzag pattern ([**14:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=860s)). Press a small knob of solid butter into the exposed filling spaces between the dough gaps ([**17:32**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=1052s)). Fold the overhanging edge crusts together and press firmly with the tines of a fork to crimp the entire border shut ([**15:46**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=946s)). []
recipe-section-9.html: • Lay the cut strips over the top of the blueberries in a woven lattice or a clean zigzag pattern (14:20). Press a small knob of solid butter into the exposed filling spaces between the dough gaps (17:32). Fold the overhanging edge crusts together and press firmly with the tines of a fork to crimp the entire border shut (15:46). []
recipe-section-9.title: Step 6: Weave and Crimp the Edges
recipe-section-9.heading_html: Step 6: Weave and Crimp the Edges

recipe-section-10.markdown: - Melt a small amount of extra butter and brush it entirely over the top of the pie lattice strips ([**18:08**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=1088s)). Generously sprinkle coarse crystal sugar over the wet butter to create a sweet, crunchy crust ([**18:29**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=1109s)). Place a baking sheet on the bottom rack of your oven to catch any boiling juices that bubble over the sides ([**13:52**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=832s)).
recipe-section-10.html: • Melt a small amount of extra butter and brush it entirely over the top of the pie lattice strips (18:08). Generously sprinkle coarse crystal sugar over the wet butter to create a sweet, crunchy crust (18:29). Place a baking sheet on the bottom rack of your oven to catch any boiling juices that bubble over the sides (13:52).
recipe-section-10.title: Step 7: Brush for a Golden Crunch
recipe-section-10.heading_html: Step 7: Brush for a Golden Crunch

recipe-section-11.markdown: Slide the pie into the center rack and bake at 205 °C for the first 20 minutes ([**16:09**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=969s)). Without removing the pie, drop the oven temperature down to 175 °C and bake for an additional 35 to 45 minutes until the crust is deeply golden and the fruit center is thick and bubbly ([**16:17**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=977s)). Let it cool for a bare minimum of 4 hours—or overnight if possible—before slicing so the juices set properly ([**18:59**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kLsLcWl_cPI&t=1139s)). []
recipe-section-11.html: Slide the pie into the center rack and bake at 205 °C for the first 20 minutes (16:09). Without removing the pie, drop the oven temperature down to 175 °C and bake for an additional 35 to 45 minutes until the crust is deeply golden and the fruit center is thick and bubbly (16:17). Let it cool for a bare minimum of 4 hours—or overnight if possible—before slicing so the juices set properly (18:59). []
